source_name: NBU Supervisory Data / Наглядова статистика
why_relevant: Central NBU hub for banking-system supervisory indicators: assets, liabilities, capital, prudential ratios, loan quality, profitability of all licensed banks, plus non-bank financial services market indicators. This is the densest statutory-disclosure node for A1 in Ukraine.

source_name: NBU Statistics section root / Статистика НБУ
why_relevant: Top-level index to all NBU statistical domains (monetary, banking, financial services market, balance of payments). Best snowball node for discovering every downstream dataset page.

source_name: NBU OpenData REST API — key bank performance indicators (basindbank)
why_relevant: Machine-readable aggregate indicators of Ukrainian banks (number of operating banks, assets, liabilities, capital) in JSON/XML — the cleanest ingestion path for time-series A1 monitoring.

source_name: NBU OpenData API — bank financial reporting / grouped balance sheets (banksfinrep)
why_relevant: Statutory financial-reporting data and grouped balance-sheet residuals of Ukrainian banks — the core statutory disclosure dataset for A1.

source_name: NBU OpenData API — bank income and expenses (banksincexp)
why_relevant: Monthly income and expense data for Ukrainian banks — the earnings backbone for tracking sector and per-bank profitability trends.

source_name: NBU Bank Directory API — Довідник банків та їх відокремлених підрозділів
why_relevant: Authoritative list of licensed banks, banks in liquidation, branches and accredited foreign-bank representative offices, derived from the State Register of Banks. The entity spine that every other A1 disclosure is joined to.

source_name: NBU Financial Stability Report / Звіт про фінансову стабільність
why_relevant: Semi-annual flagship report with sector-level capital, liquidity, profitability, asset-quality assessment and forward-looking risk views; frequently the first public articulation of supervisory concerns.

source_name: NBU Banking Sector Review / Огляд банківського сектору
why_relevant: Quarterly NBU review of banking-sector funding, lending, income and profitability — the closest thing to a sector-wide quarterly earnings commentary in Ukraine.

source_name: NBU press service — all news / Новини Національного банку
why_relevant: Primary NBU press channel: quarterly banking-sector profit announcements, licensing decisions, regulatory changes, report launches. Earnings-adjacent aggregates appear here first and drive the Ukrainian financial media cycle.

source_name: NBU Annual Report / Річний звіт Національного банку України
why_relevant: Annual NBU report (published since 1994) summarising macrofinancial and banking-sector developments, supervisory actions and sector aggregates — a canonical annual-report node for the cell.

source_name: NBU consolidated financial statements (own accounts) / Консолідована фінансова звітність НБУ
why_relevant: The central bank's own audited IFRS consolidated statements, including profit distribution to the state budget — relevant to fiscal-monetary linkage and to benchmarking sector accounting practice.

source_name: NBU Statistical Reporting Framework / Управління статистичною звітністю
why_relevant: Documents WHAT banks and non-bank institutions must report to the NBU and in what format (NBU Board Resolution No. 120 of 13.11.2018 and amendments). Tells you which disclosure files exist before they are published — essential for planning collection.

source_name: Unified Financial Reporting System rules for banks (NBU taxonomy announcement)
why_relevant: NBU rules for compiling bank financial statements under the IFRS taxonomy within Ukraine's unified Financial Reporting System (Єдина СФЗ) — governs the machine-readable format in which bank disclosures will be published, i.e. the future ingestion format.

source_name: NBU payment-market supervision: registration of payment systems, participants and technological operators
why_relevant: Payments-side counterpart of the bank register: licensing and registration of payment service providers, payment systems and technological operators under the Law on Payment Services — the authoritative actor list for the UA payments sector.

source_name: NBU oversight of financial market infrastructures / Оверсайт інфраструктур фінансового ринку
why_relevant: Annual categorisation of important payment-infrastructure objects and oversight assessments — reveals which payment systems and operators the regulator treats as systemically important, a strong proxy for market position.

source_name: data.gov.ua — National Bank of Ukraine as data publisher (organization page)
why_relevant: State open-data portal listing of every NBU dataset, with stable resource IDs and API links. Acts as a non-bot-defended mirror/index of NBU disclosures and is the fastest way to enumerate what NBU publishes.

source_name: data.gov.ua — State Register of Banks dataset (banks with licences, in liquidation, foreign branches)
why_relevant: Open-data mirror of the State Register of Banks information — licensed banks, their subdivisions, banks under liquidation, accredited foreign bank branches and representative offices.

source_name: old.bank.gov.ua — legacy bank directory search (Довідник банківських установ, що мають ліцензію)
why_relevant: Legacy NBU portal still hosting the searchable licensed-institution directory and historical pages; useful for archival lookups and for records that were not migrated to the current site.

source_name: NBU disclosure webpage for ownership structures of non-bank financial institutions
why_relevant: Announces a dedicated NBU webpage aggregating ownership-structure disclosures by non-bank financial institutions (incl. payment-sector entities NBU supervises since 2020) — a beneficial-ownership node for the payments half of the run scope.

source_name: NBU Monetary and Supervisory Statistics methodology note (M_AND_S)
why_relevant: Methodological description of how NBU builds monetary and supervisory statistics, including the 'Основні показники діяльності банків України' table. Needed to interpret series breaks and definitions correctly.

source_name: NBU OpenData REST API technical instruction
why_relevant: Full endpoint catalogue and parameter reference for the NBU OpenData REST API — the single document from which every machine-readable NBU disclosure feed can be enumerated.

source_name: Association of Ukrainian Banks (AUB) — main banking-system indicators republication
why_relevant: Industry association that republishes NBU aggregate banking-system indicators on a monthly cadence, often in more digestible tables and sometimes reachable when bank.gov.ua blocks automated access. Useful as a cross-check and fallback mirror.

source_name: Minfin.com.ua — bank statistics aggregator (Основні показники діяльності банків)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that normalises NBU bank statistics into browsable time series; convenient for quick validation and for spotting when NBU data has been updated.

source_name: PrivatBank — Financial statements (EN)
why_relevant: Primary English-language disclosure hub of Ukraine's largest bank (state-owned since 2016); hosts consolidated IFRS annual reports and audited statements used by IFIs and investors.

source_name: ПриватБанк — Інформація для акціонерів і стейкхолдерів
why_relevant: Ukrainian-language shareholder/stakeholder page — the closest thing PrivatBank has to an IR section; corporate governance, management report, shareholder (MoF) communications.

source_name: PrivatBank Integrated Report (annual, EN/UK PDF series)
why_relevant: Full IR-grade integrated annual report (strategy, digital channels, cards/acquiring volumes, ESG, risk) — richest single narrative document on the Ukrainian retail-payments leader; 2025 edition published May 2026.

source_name: ПриватБанк — Новини / прес-релізи
why_relevant: Press-release feed announcing report publication, earnings milestones (e.g. UAH 88bn pre-tax profit 2025), product and payments launches — earliest signal of new disclosures.
